 First, let's take a look at this week's major schedule on Wall Street. 
 This week, New York stock markets are expected to focus on the release of the Consumer Price Index (CPI), which will gauge the Federal Reserve's monetary policy for December, as well as the earnings reports of major AI technology companies. 
 On November 10, the October CPI and CoreWeave's earnings will be released, while Cisco and Applied Materials will report their earnings on November 12. 
 ==Clip In== {November 10, US October CPI Release.. Key Gauge for Fed's December Rate Decision} The market's greatest attention is on the October CPI, to be released on November 10. 
 Amid recent inflationary pressures, if this indicator comes in higher than expected, concerns over the possibility of additional rate hikes by the Federal Reserve could grow. 
 {November 13, Producer Price Index (PPI) Release.. Focus on Inflation Trends} On November 13, the Producer Price Index (PPI) will also be released, which is expected to provide an additional look at inflation trends in the United States. 
 {Concerns Over Stricter Environmental and Power Regulations for AI Data Centers Following Midterm Elections} Politically, the possibility of tightened environmental and power regulations on AI data centers following the US midterm elections has emerged as a major variable. 
 {Anthropic Pursues IPO Before Thanksgiving.. Monitoring Recovery of Tech Sentiment} Meanwhile, news of AI company Anthropic pursuing an initial public offering (IPO) is also drawing attention as a variable that will affect investor sentiment in tech stocks. 
 ==((ST))== Next, let's look at the US futures market. 
 Amid attention on whether bargain hunting will flow in following last week's sharp drop in tech stocks, caution persists ahead of this week's inflation indicators and AI corporate earnings. 
 US stock index futures saw the Dow futures moving around the (50,000-something) mark, Nasdaq 100 futures trading around the (20,000-something) mark, and S&P 500 futures recording the (7,000-something) mark. 
 ==((CG IN))== Russell 2000 futures moved around the (2,000-something) mark. 
 ------ Small-cap stocks are expected to react sensitively to changes in the Fed's rate outlook following the inflation release. 
 The 10-year US Treasury futures moved around the 5._____ % level. 
 The US Treasury market is paying attention to inflation pressures and the Fed's rate policy ahead of this week's CPI release, and particular interest is focused on bond yield volatility ahead of the bond market closure for Veterans Day on November 11. 
 In the commodities futures market, crude oil futures recorded the (______)-dollar mark per barrel. 
 In the crude oil market, progress in Middle East peace negotiations and uncertainties in oil supply are acting as core variables for price fluctuations.
